    VarZinho 1.0.0 API

    VarZinho captures highlights in a sports gym: every camera keeps its last 30 seconds in a circular buffer, and pressing a court's button turns that window into a permanent clip.

    It is the project for AL0330, Object-Oriented Programming, at Unipampa Alegrete. Its focus is the domain model, not video processing: fixed and PTZ cameras carry metadata only, and a phone's real .mp4 clips are written by FFmpeg, an external program, behind an interface. No frame is ever decoded in Java.

    How a capture happens

    1. A clock hands every court one second of footage, and each recording Camera writes it into its CircularBuffer, overwriting the oldest second.
    2. The operator presses a court's button. CaptureHighlight asks the Court, whose first recording camera freezes its last 30 seconds into a VideoClip, and the court stamps the clip as an immutable Highlight.
    3. The use case returns it as a PendingCapture, whose archive() stores it through HighlightRepository, in CSV files or in PostgreSQL.

    Layers

    The packages follow Clean Architecture. Each layer depends only on the layers inside it, and ArchitectureTest fails the build on any import that points outward.

    Layers, from the innermost out
    LayerPackagesHolds
    Domain structure, capture, highlight, people, enums, exception The entities and their rules. Imports nothing from the other layers, nor Swing, SQL or FFmpeg.
    Application application, application.port The use cases, the read models the window shows, and the storage contracts (ports).
    Infrastructure persistence, stream, simulation, spectator The adapters: CSV, PostgreSQL and in-memory storage, FFmpeg, the simulated clock and the public spectator view.
    Presentation ui The Swing window. Reaches the model only through the use cases and owns no business rule.
    Composition root bootstrap The one place that names every concrete adapter and puts the application together.

    Where to start reading

    • The model: Gym, Camera and its subclasses, and Highlight.
    • What the operator can do: the use cases in application.
    • How the pieces are wired: Launcher.
    • Without the window: ConsoleDemo runs the whole flow in text.
    Packages
    Package
    Description
    br.edu.unipampa.varzinho
    VarZinho's entry points: Main opens the window, and ConsoleDemo runs the whole capture flow in text, with no window.
    br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.application
    The use cases: what an operator can do, expressed against the domain and the ports, with no knowledge of Swing, files, SQL or FFmpeg.
    br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.application.port
    The contracts the use cases need from the outside world, implemented in infrastructure.persistence.
    br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.bootstrap
    The composition root: the one place that names every concrete adapter.
    br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.capture
    The cameras and the memory that makes a highlight possible.
    br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.highlight
    What a capture produces: a Highlight, its VideoClip, and HighlightTitle, the rule a highlight's name follows.
    br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.people
    The staff accounts that may operate the system.
    br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.structure
    The physical layout of a gym: the Gym and the Courts it owns, each with the cameras installed on it.
    br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.enums
    The fixed vocabularies the model shares: CameraStatus, which also holds the rule that decides whether a camera records, and Resolution, the picture size a clip is described with.
    br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.exception
    The errors the domain raises about itself, all under DomainException.
    br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.infrastructure.persistence
    The storage adapters: one CSV, one PostgreSQL and one in-memory implementation of each port in application.port.
    br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.infrastructure.simulation
    The simulated clock behind the fixed and PTZ cameras: LiveFeed hands every court one second of footage per tick.
    br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.infrastructure.spectator
    The public spectator view: a web page that streams the phone's court live and sells a clip of it through a simulated or real Pix payment.
    br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.infrastructure.stream
    The FFmpeg adapter that records a phone and writes its clips as real .mp4 files.
    br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.ui
    The Swing window: every screen the operator sees, and no business rule.
